verdict.rationale: Honeycomb provides triggers and SLO burn alerts that route to PagerDuty, Slack, or webhooks, but there is no evidence of native incident declaration, timeline tracking, on-call scheduling, or escalation policy management within Honeycomb itself — it defers those functions to external tools like PagerDuty. missing for 10: incident declaration/lifecycle tracking, on-call schedule management, escalation policy configuration.
